# Sync command: M-x org-canvas-sync-rubrics
#

#   FREE_FORM_CRITERION_COMMENTS - true | false (allow free-form comments)
#   PUBLISHED                    - true | false (default: true)
#
# Criteria are defined as Org tables under each heading:
#   | Criteria Name | Rating 1 (Pts) | Rating 2 (Pts) | ... |

* Standard Lab Rubric
:PROPERTIES:
:FREE_FORM_CRITERION_COMMENTS: false
:END:

This rubric is used for all weekly lab reports.

| Criteria                  | 10 pts (Exemplary)                                              | 8 pts (Proficient)                                           | 5 pts (Developing)                          | 0 pts (Missing)  |
|---------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+------------------|
| Introduction & Hypothesis | Clear context, well-defined problem, and testable hypothesis.   | Context provided, hypothesis present but slightly vague.     | Missing context or non-testable hypothesis. | Section missing. |
| Methodology               | Procedures described clearly; reproducible by others.           | Procedures described but lacks some detail for reproduction. | Procedures vague or confusing.              | Section missing. |
| Results & Data            | Data organized clearly (tables/graphs), relevant to hypothesis. | Data present but lacks clear organization or labels.         | Data incomplete or disorganized.            | Section missing. |
| Analysis & Conclusion     | Deep analysis of results, connecting back to theory.            | Analysis present but superficial; some connections missing.  | Analysis incorrect or missing logic.        | Section missing. |
| Formatting & Grammar      | Professional formatting, no errors.                             | Readable, minor errors.                                      | Poor formatting, distracting errors.        | Unreadable.      |

* Final Presentation Rubric
:PROPERTIES:
:FREE_FORM_CRITERION_COMMENTS: true
:END:

Rubric for the end-of-term group presentations. Rewritten to match the Lab Rubric's point scale.

| Criteria             | 10 pts (Exemplary)                                                     | 8 pts (Proficient)                                        | 5 pts (Developing)                                 | 0 pts (Missing)                   |
|----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------|
| Content Accuracy     | Content is technically accurate, comprehensive, and well-researched.   | Content is mostly accurate; minor errors or omissions.    | Significant inaccuracies or major topics missing.  | Content is incoherent or missing. |
| Visual Aids (Slides) | Slides are visually appealing, readable, and enhance the presentation. | Slides are functional but may be text-heavy or cluttered. | Slides are distracting, unreadable, or irrelevant. | No visual aids provided.          |
| Oral Delivery        | Clear voice, excellent eye contact, engaging style.                    | Clear voice, some reading from notes/slides.              | Monotone, reading entirely from slides/notes.      | No delivery (skipped).            |
| Q&A Handling         | Answers questions confidently and accurately.                          | Answers questions but shows some hesitation.              | Unable to answer basic questions related to topic. | Did not participate in Q&A.       |
| Time Management      | Finished exactly within the allotted time window (10-12 mins).         | Slightly over or under time (+/- 2 mins).                 | Significantly off time target.                     | Presentation did not occur.       |
